docs.text: Generate printable TriOrb markers and export them as SVG or PDF. (function () { const iframe = document.getElementById('generator-iframe'); if (!iframe) return; const defaultHeight = 960; const baseSrc = iframe.getAttribute('src').split('?')[0]; const query = window.location.search || ''; let contentHeight = defaultHeight; function getAvailableHeight() { const footer = document.querySelector('footer.col-md-12'); const footerHeight = footer ? footer.getBoundingClientRect().height : 0; const frameTop = iframe.getBoundingClientRect().top; const availableHeight = window.innerHeight - frameTop - footerHeight; return Math.max(defaultHeight, Math.floor(availableHeight)); } function syncFrameHeight(nextContentHeight) { if (nextContentHeight != null) { contentHeight = Math.max(defaultHeight, Number(nextContentHeight) || 0); } const height = Math.max(contentHeight, getAvailableHeight()); iframe.style.height = height + 'px'; } window.addEventListener('message', function (event) { if (!event || !event.data || event.data.type !== 'triorb-generator-height') { return; } syncFrameHeight(event.data.height); }); window.addEventListener('resize', function () { syncFrameHeight(); }); iframe.addEventListener('load', function () { requestAnimationFrame(function () { syncFrameHeight(); }); }); syncFrameHeight(defaultHeight); iframe.setAttribute('src', baseSrc + query); })();
